name: Directa S.I.M.p.A.
summary: Directa S.I.M.p.A. is an Italian company specializing in online brokerage services. It provides investment platforms that allow clients to trade a broad spectrum of financial instruments, including equities, fixed-income securities, certificates, covered warrants, futures, LMAX exchange Contracts for Difference (CFDs), mutual funds, options, and exchange-traded products such as ETFs, ETCs, and ETNs. The firm, founded in 1995, has its primary office located in Turin, Italy.
